primary_interest.quote: I read your note about voice AI agents for appointment booking.

use_case.quote: We want voice agents that answer, find an open slot, book it, and send a confirmation.

inference_framing.quote: We host that inference on our side, so it's part of the same agent setup rather than another vendor you wire in.

inference_raised_by.quote: the agent needs an LLM behind it to understand the caller and decide what to do.

competitors_inference.quote: We've been testing Fireworks for that, with Mistral Large and Llama 3.3 70B.

competitors_voice.quote: Twilio for our basic voice and SMS. For the agent piece we've been prototyping with Retell AI

decision_criteria.quote: We'd rather consolidate with one vendor for cloud and AI if we can, instead of three contracts and three dashboards.

stated_reason.quote: the Fireworks quote came in around $0.4 per million tokens, and yours was about $0.86.
